description: Unit tests for the MemoryStore component in the Mattermost server configuration, testing file operations such as get, set, has, remove, and string representation.

methods.name: setupConfigMemory
methods.description: Helper function to clear environment variables for tests.

methods.name: TestMemoryGetFile
methods.description: Tests retrieving files from the memory store, including error cases and successful retrieval.

methods.name: TestMemorySetFile
methods.description: Tests setting new files and overwriting existing files in the memory store.

methods.name: TestMemoryHasFile
methods.description: Tests checking existence of files in the memory store, including non-existent, existing, and manually added files.

methods.name: TestMemoryRemoveFile
methods.description: Tests removing files from the memory store, including non-existent, existing, and manually added files.

methods.name: TestMemoryStoreString
methods.description: Tests the string representation of the memory store.
